title: Davis–Putnam elimination and measured resolution search from covered stages
claims: DavisPutnamElimination proves preservation of satisfiability and EliminationOrderRefutation turns covered elimination stages into a strict resolution refutation.
MeasuredPivotClauseFilter and MeasuredDavisPutnamStep give exact canonical polynomial-time computation of a single elimination step.
MeasuredCNFIntersection retains exactly the universe representatives of a candidate formula and preserves universe ordering.
MeasuredEliminationOrderResolutionSearch returns a checked resolution trace on unsatisfiable canonical inputs with a supplied universe covering all stages of a covering variable order.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
